title: Prime Minister offers prayers to Maa Katyayani during Navratri
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, offered prayers to Maa Katyayani on the sacred occasion of Shashthi during Navratri.
The Prime Minister wished that, with her blessings, everyone’s life be filled with immense strength, courage and positive energy.
Shri Modi wrote on X;
“नवरात्रि की पवित्र षष्ठी पर मां कात्यायनी के श्रीचरणों में कोटि-कोटि नमन! मेरी कामना है कि उनकी अनुकंपा से हर किसी के जीवन में असीम शक्ति, साहस और सकारात्मक ऊर्जा का संचार हो।”
